assertions.description: The trace shows that starting-initiatives was loaded.

evals.prompt: In D7Y, start an initiative to investigate whether independent consultants need an agent-assisted way to turn client calls into scoped proposals. (Runtime note: no d7y executable is reachable in this workspace — neither on PATH nor at the orientation-documented path.)

evals.prompt: create initiative called fuzzy finance tracker
evals.expected_output: A thin artifact whose sections read from the request only: sections the request does not support are marked Unknown, any inference sits in Assumptions and is labeled, and no user segment, sub-activity, mechanism, or example is invented.

assertions.description: Outcome and Primary uncertainty contain no concrete sub-activities, mechanisms, or examples (e.g. transactions, categorization, estimates) that the name-only prompt did not supply.
Sections the request does not support (notably Subject and Constraints when unstated) read Unknown rather than being filled.
Exactly one initiatives/<slug>/initiative.md exists and conforms to the organization contract.

evals.prompt: create initiative called fuzzy inventory management.
